t2.title: Technology make us more alone or more connected
t2.prompt: You are participating in an online discussion forum. The topic is: “Does technology make us more alone or more connected?” Write your response, giving reasons and examples. Write 180-200 words.
t2.sample:
```html

Hey everyone,

It's fascinating how technology advancements have transformed our lives, but when it comes to whether they make us feel more connected or alone, the answer isn't black and white. I mean, on one hand, technology has undeniably bridged the gap between people living continents apart. Social media platforms like Facebook, Instagram, and Twitter allow us to keep in touch and share our lives, giving us the chance to maintain friendships that might have otherwise fizzled out. For instance, I've been able to reconnect with old school friends I haven't seen in years.

However, it's undeniably true that technology can also make us feel isolated. We often find ourselves in the same room with our friends or family, but everyone’s eyes are glued to their screens, engrossed in their own digital world. It’s ironic, isn’t it? Sometimes, it feels like we're more connected to our devices than to the people around us.

Personally, I think the key here is balance. We should make conscious efforts to use technology as a tool to enhance our connections, not replace them. Let's not forget the power of a simple hello in person!

What do you guys think? Are we more alone or more connected thanks to technology?

Looking forward to hearing your thoughts!

```
t2.sampleA1:
Hi!
I like phone. I talk to my mom. My mom is far. I see photos. Photos are good. I like my friends. Bye!
t2.sampleA2:
Hello,
I think technology is good and bad. I can talk to my friends online. But sometimes I play games and I don't talk to my family. My family is sad. I think it is better to talk to people in person. But technology is also good because I can learn new things. I like videos about animals. Bye.
t2.sampleB1:
Hi everyone,
I think technology is a difficult topic. On one hand, it helps us connect with people who live far away. For example, I can talk to my cousins in another country. Also, I can find information easily.

However, I also think technology can make us feel alone. Sometimes, people spend too much time on their phones and they don't talk to the people around them. This is not good. In my opinion, it is important to use technology in a balanced way. We should use it to connect with people, but we should also spend time with people in real life. It's important to find a good balance. What do you think?
t2.sampleB2: Hey everyone, Great topic — this one really gets people talking! Personally, I think technology is a bit of a double-edged sword when it comes to how connected we feel. On the plus side, it has completely broken down the barriers of distance. Thanks to video calls and messaging apps, I can catch up with my cousins abroad in seconds, and I've even reconnected with old classmates I'd lost touch with years ago. For a lot of people, that constant contact is a real lifeline. That said, I can't help feeling there's a downside too. How many times have you sat at dinner while everyone's glued to their phones? We're technically together, yet miles apart. Endless scrolling can leave us comparing our lives to everyone else's, which is a fast track to feeling low. At the end of the day, I reckon it all comes down to how we use it. Set a few boundaries, put the phone away now and then, and technology becomes a brilliant way to stay close to the people who matter. What's your take? Do you feel more connected or more alone these days? Looking forward to your replies! Dilshod
t2.uzSample:
Hammaga salom,

Texnologiya yutuqlari hayotimizni qanchalik o'zgartirgani hayratlanarli, lekin ular bizni ko'proq bog'langan his qildirishadimi yoki yolg'iz, degan savolga kelganda, javob bir tomonlama emas. Ya'ni, bir tomondan, texnologiya qit'alararo yashaydigan odamlar o'rtasidagi tafovutni bartaraf etdi, inkor etib bo'lmaydi. Facebook, Instagram va Twitter kabi ijtimoiy media platformalari bizga aloqada bo'lish va hayotimizni baham ko'rish imkonini beradi, bu esa boshqa yo'l bilan so'nib qolishi mumkin bo'lgan do'stlikni saqlab qolish imkoniyatini beradi. Misol uchun, men yillar davomida ko'rmagan eski maktabdoshlarim bilan qayta bog'lana oldim.

Biroq, texnologiya bizni yolg'iz his qilishga majbur qilishi ham haqiqat ekanini inkor etib bo'lmaydi. Ko'pincha o'zimizni do'stlarimiz yoki oilamiz bilan bir xonada topamiz, lekin hamma o'z ekranlariga yopishib olgan, o'zlarining raqamli dunyosiga sho'ng'igan. Bu g'alati, shunday emasmi? Ba'zan, biz atrofimizdagi odamlarga qaraganda qurilmalarimizga ko'proq bog'langanmiz, deb tuyuladi.

Shaxsan men, bu erda asosiy narsa muvozanat deb o'ylayman. Biz texnologiyadan aloqalarimizni kuchaytirish uchun vosita sifatida foydalanishga ongli ravishda harakat qilishimiz kerak, ularni almashtirish uchun emas. Shaxsan oddiy salomning kuchini unutmaylik!

Sizlar nima deb o'ylaysizlar? Texnologiya tufayli biz ko'proq yolg'izmi yoki ko'proq bog'langanmizmi?

Fikrlaringizni eshitishni intiqlik bilan kutaman!
t2.uzSampleA1:
Salom!
Menga telefon yoqadi. Men onam bilan gaplashaman. Onam uzoqda. Men suratlarni ko'raman. Suratlar yaxshi. Menga do'stlarim yoqadi. Xayr!
t2.uzSampleA2:
Salom,
Menimcha, texnologiya yaxshi ham, yomon ham. Men do'stlarim bilan onlayn gaplasha olaman. Lekin ba'zida men o'yinlar o'ynayman va oilam bilan gaplashmayman. Oilam xafa bo'ladi. Menimcha, odamlar bilan shaxsan gaplashish yaxshiroq. Lekin texnologiya ham yaxshi, chunki men yangi narsalarni o'rgana olaman. Menga hayvonlar haqidagi videolar yoqadi. Xayr.
t2.uzSampleB1:
Hammaga salom,
Menimcha, texnologiya murakkab mavzu. Bir tomondan, u uzoqda yashaydigan odamlar bilan bog'lanishimizga yordam beradi. Misol uchun, men boshqa davlatdagi amakivachchalarim bilan gaplasha olaman. Shuningdek, men osongina ma'lumot topa olaman.

Biroq, menimcha, texnologiya bizni yolg'iz his qilishimizga ham olib kelishi mumkin. Ba'zan odamlar telefonlarida juda ko'p vaqt o'tkazadilar va atrofidagi odamlar bilan gaplashmaydilar. Bu yaxshi emas. Mening fikrimcha, texnologiyadan muvozanatli tarzda foydalanish muhim. Biz undan odamlar bilan bog'lanish uchun foydalanishimiz kerak, lekin biz haqiqiy hayotda ham odamlar bilan vaqt o'tkazishimiz kerak. Yaxshi muvozanatni topish muhim. Siz nima deb o'ylaysiz?
t2.uzSampleB2:
Salom,
Texnologiya bizni yolg'izlatadimi yoki bog'laydimi degan savol murakkab va menimcha, javob o'rtada joylashgan. Texnologiya aloqa uchun misli ko'rilmagan imkoniyatlarni taqdim etishi inkor etib bo'lmaydi. Masalan, ijtimoiy media platformalari bizga geografik chegaralar bo'ylab odamlar bilan munosabatlarni saqlashga va o'tmishdagi shaxslar bilan qayta bog'lanishga imkon beradi. Men chet elga ko'chib ketgan do'stlarim bilan osonlikcha aloqada bo'lishim mumkin, bu ilgari mumkin bo'lmagan edi.

Biroq, onlayn muloqotning qulayligi yuzma-yuz aloqaning pasayishiga ham olib kelishi mumkin. Biz soatlab ijtimoiy tarmoqlarni ko'rib chiqishga, boshqalarning hayotini passiv kuzatishga sarflashimiz mumkin, atrofimizdagi odamlar bilan mazmunli suhbatlashish o'rniga. Bu, hatto boshqalar bilan o'ralashgan bo'lsak ham, yolg'izlik hissini yaratishi mumkin. Bundan tashqari, onlayn profillarning tartibga solinganligi yetishmovchilik va ijtimoiy taqqoslash hissini keltirib chiqarishi mumkin, bu esa yolg'izlik hissini yanada kuchaytiradi. Oxir oqibat, menimcha, texnologiyaning aloqa tuyg'usiga ta'siri biz uni qanday ishlatishni tanlashimizga bog'liq. Agar biz chinakam muloqot va ongli ishtirokni ustuvor deb bilsak, texnologiya munosabatlarni qurish va saqlash uchun kuchli vosita bo'lishi mumkin. Ammo agar biz unga yuzma-yuz muloqot va real dunyo tajribalarini almashtirishga ruxsat bersak, u, shubhasiz, yolg'izlik hissini kuchaytirishi mumkin.

t12.title: formal letter · to coordinator
t12.prompt: Write a letter to the project coordinator. Write about your feelings and what you think the coordinator should do. Write your response in 120-150 words.
t12.sample:
Dear Coordinator,

I hope this message finds you well. I’m genuinely thrilled about the opportunity to contribute new ideas for our community. I believe we should focus on projects that support the elderly population. They often face loneliness and require assistance with daily tasks. Initiatives like organizing regular social gatherings or offering technology workshops to help them stay connected could be incredibly beneficial.

Moreover, why not set up an animal rescue program? Animals, especially strays, might be in dire need of care. It could greatly enrich our community by fostering empathy and responsibility among volunteers.

To encourage people to get involved, we could launch awareness campaigns in local schools and businesses. Offering small incentives, like certificates or public recognition, might also motivate participation. I’m absolutely convinced that by showcasing the emotional rewards of volunteering, we could draw in more volunteers.

Thank you for considering these ideas. I look forward to seeing our community flourish.

Warm regards,
Rayhona Salimova
t12.sampleA1:
Hi Coordinator,
I want help. Help animals. I like dogs and cats. I want people help too. It is good. Bye.
t12.sampleA2:
Hi Coordinator,
I want to help. I think we can help children. They need help with school. We can read books with them. And we can play games. It is fun! More people can help if we ask them. Maybe we can give them food. Thank you.
Bye,Rayhona Salimova
t12.sampleB1:
Dear Coordinator,
I am writing to you with some ideas for volunteer projects. I think it would be good to help elderly people. They sometimes need help with shopping or cleaning. We could visit them and talk to them.
Also, we could help animals. There are many stray cats and dogs. We could give them food and find homes for them. To get more people involved, we could put up posters and tell our friends. In my opinion, it is important to help others.
Thank you for reading my ideas.
Sincerely,
Rayhona Salimova
t12.sampleB2: Dear Coordinator, I am writing to share how excited I am about the group's new plans, and to put forward a few ideas of my own. In my view, we should focus our energy on supporting elderly people, many of whom struggle with loneliness and everyday tasks. Regular visits, along with simple technology classes, would help them stay in touch with their families and feel part of the community again. To get more people on board, I believe you should launch a short social media campaign showing the real difference our work makes. Offering flexible schedules and clearly defined roles would also make it far easier for busy people to sign up. I am confident that, with a clear plan, we can bring in plenty of new volunteers. Thank you for taking my suggestions into account. Yours sincerely, Bekzod Aliyev
t12.uzSample:
Hurmatli Koordinator,

Umid qilamanki, ushbu xabar sizga yaxshi yetib borgan. Bizning jamiyatimiz uchun yangi g'oyalar kiritish imkoniyatidan chin dildan xursandman. Menimcha, biz keksa avlodni qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan loyihalarga e'tibor qaratishimiz kerak. Ular ko'pincha yolg'izlikka duch kelishadi va kundalik vazifalarda yordamga muhtoj bo'lishadi. Muntazam ijtimoiy uchrashuvlar tashkil etish yoki ularga aloqada bo'lishga yordam beradigan texnologiya bo'yicha seminarlar taklif qilish kabi tashabbuslar juda foydali bo'lishi mumkin.

Bundan tashqari, nega hayvonlarni qutqarish dasturini tashkil qilmaymiz? Hayvonlar, ayniqsa, daydi hayvonlar, g'amxo'rlikka juda muhtoj bo'lishi mumkin. Bu ko'ngillilar o'rtasida hamdardlik va mas'uliyatni rivojlantirish orqali jamiyatimizni sezilarli darajada boyitishi mumkin.

Odamlarni jalb qilish uchun biz mahalliy maktablar va korxonalarda xabardorlik kampaniyalarini boshlashimiz mumkin. Sertifikatlar yoki ommaviy e'tirof kabi kichik rag'batlantirishlar ham ishtirok etishga undashi mumkin. Ko'ngillilikning hissiy mukofotlarini namoyish etish orqali biz ko'proq ko'ngillilarni jalb qila olishimizga mutlaqo aminman.

Ushbu g'oyalarni ko'rib chiqayotganingiz uchun tashakkur. Jamiyatimizning gullab-yashnashini ko'rishni intiqlik bilan kutaman.

Ilg'or hurmat bilan,
Rayhona Salimova

Menga yordam kerak. Hayvonlarga yordam berish kerak. Menga itlar va mushuklar yoqadi. Odamlarga ham yordam berishlarini xohlayman. Bu yaxshi. Xayr.
t12.uzSampleA2:
Salom Koordinator,
Men yordam berishni xohlayman. O'ylaymanki, biz bolalarga yordam bera olamiz. Ularga maktabda yordam kerak. Biz ular bilan kitob o'qishimiz mumkin. Va biz o'yinlar o'ynashimiz mumkin. Bu qiziqarli! Agar biz ulardan so'rasak, ko'proq odamlar yordam berishi mumkin. Balki biz ularga ovqat berishimiz mumkin. Rahmat.
Xayr,Rayhona Salimova
t12.uzSampleB1:
Hurmatli Koordinator,
Men sizga ko'ngillilik loyihalari uchun ba'zi g'oyalar bilan murojaat qilyapman. O'ylashimcha, keksa odamlarga yordam berish yaxshi bo'lardi. Ularga ba'zan xarid qilish yoki tozalashda yordam kerak bo'ladi. Biz ularni ziyorat qilib, ular bilan gaplashishimiz mumkin.
Shuningdek, biz hayvonlarga yordam berishimiz mumkin. Ko'plab daydi mushuklar va itlar bor. Biz ularga ovqat berib, ular uchun uy topishimiz mumkin. Ko'proq odamlarni jalb qilish uchun biz plakatlar osib, do'stlarimizga aytishimiz mumkin. Mening fikrimcha, boshqalarga yordam berish muhim.
G'oyalarimni o'qiganingiz uchun rahmat.
Hurmat bilan,
Rayhona Salimova
t12.uzSampleB2:
Hurmatli Koordinator,
Men volontyorlik harakatlarimizga yangi g'oyalar qo'shishga bo'lgan ishtiyoqimni bildirish uchun yozyapman. Menimcha, qimmatli e'tibor jamiyatimizdagi nochor bolalarni qo'llab-quvvatlashga qaratilishi kerak. Repetitorlik dasturlari, murabbiylik imkoniyatlari yoki hatto ko'ngilochar tadbirlarni tashkil etish ularning hayotiga sezilarli ta'sir ko'rsatishi mumkin.
Bundan tashqari, biz atrof-muhit tashabbuslarini ko'rib chiqishimiz kerak. Parklarni tozalash yoki daraxt ekish tadbirlarini tashkil etish nafaqat atrofimizni yaxshilaydi, balki ekologik mas'uliyat haqida xabardorlikni oshiradi. Kengroq ishtirokni rag'batlantirish uchun biz ijtimoiy tarmoqlardan volontyorlikning ijobiy natijalarini namoyish etish va olingan ko'nikmalarni ta'kidlash uchun foydalanishimiz mumkin.
Moslashuvchan volontyorlik jadvallarini va aniq belgilangan rollarni taklif qilish ham odamlarning o'z vaqtlarini ajratishini osonlashtiradi. Ushbu takliflarni amalga oshirish orqali biz jamiyatimizga ta'sirimizni kuchaytirishimiz va ko'proq ko'ngillilarni jalb qilishimizga ishonaman.
Hurmat bilan,
Rayhona Salimova
